rationale: Moves the pinned Skia/Dawn render provider from chrome/m153 to chrome/m157: manifest digests, VERSION.md provenance, visual-harness Dockerfile and pins mirrors, and the m153+ capability probe (now a client-owned SkExecutor compiled without RTTI, since m157 removed Skia's executor factories). V8 stays on its verified m153 release under a declared independent_skia_advance because the matched m157 V8 fails the cube-capture gate. Raster text dependencies (HarfBuzz, ICU) and the skia-python golden wheel are unchanged, so the visual-harness PNG golden and its digest are untouched. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
